name: CONCAT
description: Concatenates values and treats NULL as empty string; preferred over '+' for portable string concatenation in T-SQL.

name: CONCAT_WS
description: Concatenates values with a separator and skips NULL inputs.

name: STRING_AGG
description: Aggregates rows into one delimited string; supports WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ...) in modern SQL Server.

name: LEN
description: Returns character length excluding trailing spaces; differs from byte-length semantics.

name: DATALENGTH
description: Returns storage size in bytes, useful for NVARCHAR/VARCHAR and binary payload checks.

name: CHARINDEX
description: Finds substring position (1-based). Returns 0 if not found.

name: PATINDEX
description: Pattern search with LIKE-style wildcards; returns first match position.

name: SUBSTRING
description: Extracts substring with 1-based start index.

name: STUFF
description: Deletes part of a string and inserts another string at a specified position.

name: REPLACE
description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring.

name: GETDATE
description: Returns current local datetime as DATETIME (lower precision than SYSDATETIME).

name: SYSDATETIME
description: Returns current local datetime as DATETIME2 with higher precision.

name: DATEADD
description: Adds a datepart interval to a datetime value.

name: DATEDIFF
description: Returns count of datepart boundary crossings between two datetimes.

name: DATETRUNC
description: Truncates datetime to a specified datepart (SQL Server 2022+).

name: EOMONTH
description: Returns end-of-month date, with optional month offset.

name: DATEFROMPARTS
description: Builds DATE from year, month, day parts.

name: CAST
description: Standard type conversion expression.

name: CONVERT
description: T-SQL type conversion with optional style code (especially for date/time and string formatting).

name: TRY_CAST
description: Like CAST but returns NULL on conversion failure instead of error.

name: TRY_CONVERT
description: Like CONVERT but returns NULL on conversion failure.

name: PARSE
description: Culture-aware string to date/number conversion via CLR; slower, use selectively.

name: TRY_PARSE
description: Culture-aware PARSE variant returning NULL on failure.

name: ISNULL
description: Two-argument null replacement; return type follows first argument in T-SQL.

name: COALESCE
description: Returns first non-NULL expression; standard SQL semantics with type precedence rules.
